offerings.name: Transport
offerings.verb: sketch a route without accepting goods

recipes.title: The Tomato Telegraph
recipes.first: Make a one-page proposed surplus-offer card and invite a food-access reviewer to improve it.
recipes.gate: Food handling and distribution need qualified review and real recipient consent.

recipes.title: The Porchlight Chorus
recipes.first: Write a 15-minute, zero-pressure song-sharing invitation; ask a willing musician for feedback.
recipes.gate: No venue or performer has agreed. Check host permission and music rights.

recipes.title: The Tiny Trail Quest
recipes.first: Draft a 30-minute cleanup question card and identify the actual land manager.
recipes.gate: No cleanup until site authorization and safety/disposal rules are confirmed.

recipes.title: Paper Portal
recipes.first: Draft one small invitation landing page and ten optional question cards.
recipes.gate: No organization endorsement or confirmed invitees.

recipes.title: Repairing the Rainbow
recipes.first: Sketch one nonhazardous skill-sharing or art-repair demo.
recipes.gate: No mains power, hazardous tools or safety-critical equipment.

recipes.title: The Unpromised Delivery
recipes.first: Make a hypothetical route-and-questions card; ask whether a real safe need exists.
recipes.gate: No food pickup or delivery until authorized food-safety and recipient procedures exist.

genericFallback.title: Two Little Sparks
genericFallback.first: Combine two genuine offers into one paper-only voluntary question card. Ask one willing person what should change.
genericFallback.gate: No real participants, events, transport, financial commitments or physical actions are implied.
